newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish Q4 avg household spending rose 2.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Q4 avg household spending rose 2.48 pct.

text.p: Average spending in Spanish households rose 2.48 percent in the 1996 fourth quarter year on year in current peseta terms, the National Statistics Institute INE said on Monday.
This compares with 1.89 percent growth in the third quarter.
Household spending rose 6.28 percent in the fourth quarter from the third. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
